content.title: VFC Q3 Deep Dive: Turnaround Progress Tempered by Persistent Brand Challenges and Tariff Headwinds
content.summary: Lifestyle clothing conglomerate VF Corp (NYSE:VFC) reported Q3 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, but sales fell by 3.5% year on year to $2.80 billion. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $2.90 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.52 per share was 22.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
